title: LexKairos: Benchmarking Legal Temporal Capabilities in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.09106v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of legal tasks. In legal practice, time is a critical concept that governs the validity of statutes, the progression of legal cases, and the enforcement of procedural deadlines. However, legal temporal capabilities remain underexplored in existing legal AI benchmarks. To address this gap, we propose LexKairos, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the temporal capabilities of LLMs in the Chinese legal context across three dimensions: statutory temporal knowledge, case temporal modeling, and statute-case temporal reasoning. LexKairos comprises nine sub-tasks drawn from real-world Chinese judicial cases and statutes. We conduct systematic evaluations of eight LLMs under multiple inference settings, including vanilla, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), and thinking modes. translated_title: LexKairos：评估法律大语言模型时间能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在各种法律任务中展现出强劲性能。在法律实践中，时间是决定法规有效性、案件进展以及程序期限执行的关键概念。然而，现有的法律AI基准测试对法律时间能力的探索仍然不足。为解决这一缺口，我们提出了LexKairos，一个全面的基准测试，用于评估LLMs在中国法律语境下的时间能力，涵盖三个维度：法规时间知识、案件时间建模以及法规-案件时间推理。LexKairos包含九个从真实中国司法案例和法规中提取的子任务。我们在多种推理设置下对八个LLM进行了系统评估，包括标准模式、思维链（CoT）和思考模式。结果表明，Gemini-3-Flash实现了最强的整体性能，但即便是它也存在局限性。
tldr: 本文提出了LexKairos基准，用于系统评估大语言模型在中国法律语境下的时间能力，涵盖法规知识、案件建模和推理三个维度，并发现当前模型在该领域仍存在显著不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LexKairos, a benchmark for systematically evaluating LLMs' temporal capabilities in the Chinese legal context across statutory knowledge, case modeling, and reasoning, revealing significant limitations in current models.
